summary: inventory_hostname can be an alias, with ansible_host and ansible_port giving the real address; aliases also let you target the same host more than once, though tasks may run in parallel.
questions: How do I give a host a short alias in inventory?
How do I connect to a host on a different IP than its name?
Can I list the same server twice in inventory?

answer_card.title: Inventory aliases
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
jumper ansible_port=5555 ansible_host=192.0.2.50
```
Running against `jumper` connects to 192.0.2.50:5555.

Two aliases (`jumper1`, `jumper2`) pointing to the same address let you target one host twice, but remember tasks can run on them in parallel.
